Telangana CM Orders Probe into Nurse's Alleged Rape-Murder

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has ordered a speedy investigation and a magisterial inquiry into the alleged rape and murder of a nurse. The incident occurred in Telangana. Details regarding the victim or the circumstances of the alleged crime were not specified in the coverage.
